caseStudies.title: context-engine-mcp
caseStudies.problem: AI coding agents can't see large or multi-repo codebases.
caseStudies.did: Built an MCP server that indexes code and searches it by meaning.
caseStudies.result: Any MCP client gets relevant code context on demand.
caseStudies.details: Open-source MCP server with these tools: index_repository, search_codebase, get_file_context, refresh_changed_files, list_repositories and compare_branches. It uses tree-sitter AST chunking, local fastembed embeddings, Qdrant, incremental hash-based indexing and branch-aware search. It has an HTTP mode with token auth, path validation, and a VPS deployment with a systemd timer. Works with MCP clients such as Claude, Cursor and VS Code.

caseStudies.title: discord-triage-agent
caseStudies.problem: Support questions pile up and each needs triage.
caseStudies.did: Classified messages with Jev and a threshold, added a Bedrock answer agent.
caseStudies.result: Questions get sorted and answered without a person reading each one.
caseStudies.details: Open-source showcase repo: Jev triage with a confidence threshold, a Bedrock answer agent behind a feature flag, Docker Compose and CI. A production version of the same idea adds RAG over a codebase and runs on a VPS.

caseStudies.title: Fulepu
caseStudies.problem: A learning company's apps ran on scattered legacy services.
caseStudies.did: Migrated their apps to AWS with Cognito single sign-on.
caseStudies.result: Their apps now run on one AWS stack with one login.
caseStudies.details: Fulepu is a learning and organizational development company. I moved their web apps off Firebase, Clerk, Convex and Appwrite onto AWS: Cognito for login, DynamoDB for data, S3 with CloudFront for media and Amplify for hosting, with the infrastructure defined in AWS CDK. Cognito also gives single sign-on between the apps and their WordPress portal. I added transactional email with SES and scheduled jobs with EventBridge.

caseStudies.details: The link is the client's public site. The tool itself is a private internal tool that imports DIAN invoices, reconciles them against bank statements and files them to Google Drive.

caseStudies.title: HostReach

caseStudies.title: context-engine-mcp
caseStudies.problem: Los agentes de código no ven bases de código grandes o multi-repo.
caseStudies.did: Construí un servidor MCP que indexa código y lo busca por significado.
caseStudies.result: Cualquier cliente MCP obtiene contexto de código relevante bajo demanda.
caseStudies.details: Servidor MCP de código abierto con estas herramientas: index_repository, search_codebase, get_file_context, refresh_changed_files, list_repositories y compare_branches. Usa fragmentación por AST con tree-sitter, embeddings locales con fastembed, Qdrant, indexación incremental por hash y búsqueda por rama. Tiene un modo HTTP con token, validación de rutas y despliegue en un VPS con un timer de systemd. Funciona con clientes MCP como Claude, Cursor y VS Code.
